key_terms.الْبَاطِلَ: the falsehood (referring to the opposing forces)
key_terms.الْحَقُّ: the truth (referring to Imam Ali's cause)
key_terms.بِحَذَافِيرِهَا: with all its parts/walls, meaning completely or fully
key_terms.سَاقَتِهَا: the lead or vanguard of the battle

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his role and strategy in the Battle of the Camel?
ai.summary: In this vivid metaphor from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) describes his deep immersion in the 'roots' of the conflict, emphasizing that his persistence was neither due to inability nor cowardice but a deliberate strategic resolve. This passage underscores the Shia theological view of his leadership as an active struggle to purify truth from the distortions of falsehood, a theme central to his caliphate's narrative.

en.sayed-ali-raza: surely I was in their lead till it took shape with its walls. I did not show weakness or cowardice. My existing march is also like that. I shall certainly pierce the wrong till right comes out of its side.
